_comment: Q86 inc.8 — the FIRST of the five unwired sources to be wired. Fathom's own list of every recording it holds for Rob, read live through the Fathom MCP in an agent session (node cannot reach it: there is no Fathom key in .env.local, same shape as the calendar snapshot). Read-only. Nothing here was written back to Fathom.
_pii: REDACTED IN CODE, not after the fact: the MCP returns `recorded_by` and `calendar_invitees` as EMAIL ADDRESSES for every row (attendees of Rob's real meetings). Those fields are dropped at capture and never enter git — the same subtraction scripts/calendar-snapshot-from-mcp.mjs performs on the calendar. Titles are kept because the calendar snapshot keeps `summary` and the spine joins on title.
_transcriptClaim: LOCATED, NOT READ — for every row except the one marked transcriptConfirmed. Fathom transcribes what it records, but 'the tool usually does X' is not evidence about THIS meeting, and a hasTranscript:true nobody verified is INCIDENT-LEDGER #22/#34 in one field. A row is only confirmed when a summary or transcript was actually fetched and came back non-empty, and the increment that confirmed it says so.
